representative_roster.graph: full encountered WikiCS native roles; TRAIN580/VALID5274; TEST closed
representative_roster.genuine_I4_strengthening: Supersedes predecessor narrow one-direction I4. Same observed graph/features/labels, four learned signatures and nonlinear H-input residual per body versus one scalar direction/linear residual per candidate route. Information/readout capacity and sorting work deliberately richer; no equal-parameter/equal-operation claim.
representative_roster.plain_references: Closed native ordinary/factorized single/I4/shared archives as contextual references; no sixth fresh arm added.

arms.native_routes: one per separately fitted body, four pooled at serving
arms.residual: four separately fitted all-signature nonlinear residuals
arms.role: root-strengthened capable independent ensemble; each body richer than one candidate route

root_freeze_required: Qualified source, numeric raw-accuracy/equal-calibrated-risk gates and finite execution budget; no source tuning from outcomes

directions.candidate_and_moment: U_raw[4,D], one learned private direction per live native route
directions.common_direction_control: U_raw[1,D], one learned direction used with each different H_m; private V_m remain; signatures are not asserted equal
directions.all_signature_M1_and_each_I4_copy: U_raw[4,D], four learned directions applied to the one body H; four signatures, one corrected class vector
directions.forward: u = U_raw / norm(U_raw, dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1e-8); a=H dot u
directions.initialization: CPU float32 standard-normal torch.randn using a fresh local CPU Generator per direction; fixed draw only, no search or global/native/dropout RNG advancement
directions.optimization: Raw vectors are ordinary trainable parameters; differentiate normalization; no orthogonalization, retraction, direction penalty or gradient rerouting.

residuals.candidate: Private V[4,4,C]; route m adds t_m @ V[m]; all entries zero; no added bias
residuals.moment: Private V[4,5,C]; same zero initialization/no bias
residuals.common_direction: Private V[4,4,C], same zero initialization/no bias

all_signature_M1_and_I4.input: concat(H, centered Q for direction0 then1 then2 then3, one log1p(d)); dimension D+13
all_signature_M1_and_I4.head: Linear(D+13,128,bias=True) -> ReLU -> Linear(128,C,bias=True)
all_signature_M1_and_I4.first_layer_initialization: Unchanged standard torch.nn.Linear reset_parameters convention inside isolated CPU RNG scope
all_signature_M1_and_I4.result: One residual [N,C], added to unchanged native Z; one corrected class vector per native body, not four pseudo-members.
all_signature_M1_and_I4.isolate_limit: The nonlinear H-input head can alter isolate logits after fitting; it is intentionally a richer capable control. Only zero-start native identity is shared with the candidate.

optimizer: Original-law AdamW lr .001, betas(.9,.999), eps1e-8, weight_decay0; all native/factor/residual/direction parameters registered before optimizer, exactly once; no new parameter-specific group or multiplier

selection.joint_shared_banks: Strict whole corrected probability-mean VALID accuracy improvement; earliest ties; original patience
selection.genuine_I4: Each body separately trained, separately optimized and selected by its own corrected VALID accuracy; no pool selector during acquisition
selection.restore: Strict complete model state including residuals/directions, optimizer and member RNG streams; no rebuild/redraw after selected state restore
selection.readouts: Archive native Z and corrected S/member probabilities separately from the same corrected-selected checkpoint; uncalibrated native and corrected probability means authoritative. Native contrasts include selection/stopping.
selection.calibration: Secondary only; policy in CALIBRATION_POLICY.json; no model/selector/objective change.
